title: Welcome challenge
description: A first competition to try the platform: a mix of writing code, fixing a bug and reading code.

title: Python sprint
description: Short, quick problems. Speed and accuracy decide it.

title: Bug hunt
description: Every program here is broken. Find the bugs and fix them.

title: Searching and sorting
description: Searching and sorting: write them, repair them and trace them.

title: Recursion
description: Functions that call themselves. No loops allowed in places.

title: Data structures
description: Stacks, queues, linked lists and trees, built and traced.

title: Robust programs
description: Validation, messy input, classes and testing: the skills of a robust program.

title: Grand final
description: The hardest set. A bit of everything.

title: Code breakers
description: Ciphers and secret messages: write them, repair one, trace one, and crack a Caesar shift without the key.

title: Trace race
description: Reading code rather than writing it: trace tables to fill in and programs to put back in order.

title: Lower sixth league
description: A friendly set for Year 12: short problems on times, lists, slices and loops.

title: Upper sixth challenge
description: For Year 13: a stack that knows its smallest item, rooms on a floor plan, recursion and a breadth-first search.

title: Winter cracker
description: A festive set for the end of the autumn term: sleighs, elves and a snowball.
